question: What security and ownership boundary should the Dashboard browser preview use before implementation?
rationale: The feature would expose sensitive browser state and current main now has generic plugin-tab plumbing, so automation cannot safely choose core versus browser-plugin UI or passive versus write-action behavior.

options.title: Read-only-first admin panel
options.body: Ship a secured panel that shows tabs, URL/title, screenshots, and logs by default while requiring explicit user steps for navigation, clicks, credential fields, and submit actions.

options.title: Browser plugin tab after API settles
options.body: Implement the browser surface as a browser-plugin Control UI tab once maintainers accept the plugin tab security and API shape.

options.title: Defer the panel
options.body: Keep existing CLI/RPC screenshot workflows until remote browser preview becomes prioritized product work.

recommendation.title: Read-only-first admin panel
recommendation.body: Ship a secured panel that shows tabs, URL/title, screenshots, and logs by default while requiring explicit user steps for navigation, clicks, credential fields, and submit actions.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from issue discussion, browser-control history, and current Control UI/browser blame.
